ticker_news.title: Is This One Number From Nvidia a Red Flag for Investors? - The Motley Fool
ticker_news.description: Nvidia has become heavily dependent on AI, with 86% of its revenue linked to this business. While this represents a risk if AI growth slows, the company's focus on a hot technology also presents an opportunity for potential explosive gains. Diversification is recommended to manage this risk.
ticker_news.author: Adria Cimino
